note: 第一套画风。半身立绘、厚涂笔触、强轮廓光、暗角背景。suffix 与 palette 对全部角色逐字相同，这是整套画风统一的唯一保证 —— 改 suffix 等于重出全套。
suffix: digital oil painting, rich impasto brushwork, dramatic chiaroscuro with a strong rim light, dark vignette background, half-body centered composition facing the viewer, square framing, high fantasy Arthurian legend, one of a matched set of ten character cards painted in an identical style by the same artist, muted desaturated palette with a single strong accent light, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no decorative border, no frame

palette.BLUE: colour palette of deep indigo, midnight blue and cold steel, with silver and pale-gold highlights
palette.RED: colour palette of dark crimson, blackened iron and deep maroon, with tarnished copper and ember-orange highlights

merlin.name: 梅林
merlin.subject: the elderly sorcerer Merlin, long silver beard, a deep hood shadowing his eyes, richly embroidered robes, holding a staff tipped with a glowing star, faint constellations turning slowly behind him, serene and secretive expression, a man who knows everything and may say nothing

percival.name: 派西维尔
percival.subject: an 18-year-old squire-knight Percival, clearly a teenager, golden blond hair, short and tousled, completely beardless with smooth youthful boyish skin, a slender slight build, light chainmail worn under a loose surcoat cloak, holding up a shield bearing a chalice close to his chest like a ward, clear wide watchful eyes glancing warily to one side as though weighing which of two figures to believe, a faint grail-light behind him

loyal-servant.name: 忠臣
loyal-servant.subject: a 45-year-old veteran knight, loyal servant of Arthur, dark brown hair cropped short with greying temples, a thick greying beard covering his jaw and cheeks, a broad heavy build with wide massive shoulders, plain battle-worn chainmail scarred and dented with a simple cross-emblazoned tabard, both hands resting on the pommel of a sword planted point-down before him, a weathered face lined by years of war with an old scar across the bridge of his nose, calm resolute open gaze, rows of banners fading into mist behind him

lancelot-blue.name: 蓝兰斯洛特
lancelot-blue.subject: the knight Lancelot in gleaming plate armour, long dark hair, helm held under one arm, a two-sided cloak turned so its blue side faces the viewer, a greatsword resting against his shoulder, noble and determined, a faint mirrored silhouette of himself behind him

morgana.name: 莫甘娜
morgana.subject: the sorceress Morgana, beautiful and cold, raven-black hair, an elegant gown worked with tarnished-gold filigree, a gauzy veil of shadow at her shoulders, one hand raised weaving a false light that imitates a wizard's magic, a black crescent moon behind her, a deceitful half-smile

assassin.name: 刺客
assassin.subject: a hooded assassin, the face hidden in shadow above the mouth, one eye catching a sliver of light, dark leather and a high collar, a curved dagger held reversed along the forearm, poised utterly still and waiting, embers drifting behind him

mordred.name: 莫德雷德
mordred.subject: the usurper Mordred, pale sickly bone-white skin like a man who has never seen the sun, gaunt hollow sunken cheeks and a thin sharp emaciated face, platinum-silver hair slicked straight back off his brow, a dark iron crown on his brow, regal black armour with blood-red enamel, arms folded, a cold arrogant stare, his silhouette softly swallowed by creeping shadow at the edges, wisps of dark smoke curling around him, a ruined throne behind him

oberon.name: 奥伯伦
oberon.subject: the outcast Oberon, feral and solitary, weathered ruddy skin lit by warm amber firelight, one blind milky eye and one burning ember-orange eye, no blood on his face, a jagged black-iron antlered headdress like a wild stag, a tattered dark crimson cloak over a gaunt frame, standing entirely alone in cold fog with no companion anywhere, crows scattering behind him

minion.name: 爪牙
minion.subject: a faceless minion of Mordred, wearing a full riveted iron great-helm with only a narrow horizontal eye-slit, no hood and no cloak of any kind, the bare metal helmet silhouette clearly readable against the background, broad shoulders in worn brigandine armour, a gloved hand on a short sword, a subservient forward-leaning posture, ravens perched on broken stone behind him

lancelot-red.name: 红兰斯洛特
lancelot-red.subject: the knight Lancelot fallen, unmistakably the same warrior but in blackened plate armour with red enamel, long dark hair, helm under one arm, a two-sided cloak turned so its crimson side faces the viewer, a greatsword lowered, grim and shadowed, a faint mirrored silhouette of himself behind him
